name: OBAKEIDORO 2: Chase & Seek
description:
A chase battle between Monsters and Humans! Round 2!
The new setting is Japan?!

You only have 3 minutes!
Run and hide. If even one person escapes, the Humans win!
If everyone is caught, the Monsters win!
Make use of the Monsters' special abilities to catch the Humans.
Up to 8 players can play together in Local or Online play.

Obakeidoro 2 is an asymmetrical multiplayer action game where players are split into Humans and Monsters to play chase and seek.
Aside from running and hiding, Humans can use their secret weapon, "Activate Lantern," to stun Monsters.
If used skillfully, you may be able to turn a crisis into an opportunity.
The key to winning for Monsters is through their powerful skills. Utilize unique Monster abilities, such as moving through walls or detecting footprints, to catch Humans.

◆ Work together with your friends using the new Human action, "Call"!
This newly added action enables you to call out to nearby allies.
When your allies respond, you can use cooperative actions such as "Solo Throw," "Two Person Jump," or "Bond Forger"!

◆ Round up everyone at once with the new Monster action, "Super Catch"!
Use this new action with improved range and visuals to capture the Humans!
